messages:
Morgan: kicking off envelope recipher sweep (recipher = decrypt+encrypt under new KMS keys) in us-east-1 for tenant shard 12. throttle=600r/s to start, will ramp. output logs to s3://prod-kms-rewrap/logs/1789993333
keyops-bot: job started: job_id=enc-recipher-1789993333, workers=24
Anya: quick q — do we have RBAC checks for the job role? need to ensure it can't access other customer manifests.
Sam: yes, job role is limited to prefix arn:aws:s3:::redwood-envelopes/shard-12/* and kms:Encrypt/Decrypt on alias/redwood-prod-rot-2026 only. also CloudTrail on.
Kyle: note: GCP KMS customers will use service account with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToEncrypt; double-check keyring IAM.
Irina: if we hit rate limit on KMS, what's the backoff strategy? exponential? jitter?
Morgan: implement full jitter backoff + token bucket on client side. target qps per worker = 25, global throttle via coordinator to 600r/s. if KMS returns Throttling, backoff exponentially with max-delay=30s and record metric `recipher.kms_throttle`.
Sam: adding a manifest checkpointing approach so we can resume. each manifest entry: `object_key, envelope_version, checkpoint_ts, attempt_count, status`.
Anya: audit logging requirement: every successful rewrap must emit an audit entry with old_key_id and new_key_id and job_id. Tie to request-id and Correlation-ID header in logs.
keyops-bot: sample CLI to start job:
```
redwood-cli kms recipher --shard 12 --region us-east-1 --throttle 600 --manifest s3://prod-kms-rewrap/manifests/1789993333.manifest --job-id enc-recipher-1789993333
```
Morgan: ran into 502s from the orchestrator when we spiked to 2x throttle accidentally. Rollback: paused workers, bumped token bucket cooldown, resumed at 300r/s.
Irina: what about DLQ and poison records? how many retries before DLQ? we should separate transient KMS errors vs corrupt envelope errors.
Sam: policy: retry=5 for transient (Throttling, Internal), then exponential backoff to DLQ. For corrupt envelope (bad header, missing keys) mark permanent and place into quarantine bucket s3://prod-kms-rewrap/quarantine/ with metadata for incident-review.
Kyle: to help diagnostics, add per-envelope trace id and emit structured JSON line to logs:
{"trace_id":"<uuid>","object":"key","old_key":"arn:...","new_key":"arn:...","status":"success|retry|failed","attempts":N}
Anya: RBAC note: ensure ops-read role can view manifests but not the plaintext payloads. KMS Decrypt must only be on ephemeral worker instance role during job runtime via short-lived credentials.
Morgan: observed error sample in logs:
```
2026-02-15T21:03:10Z worker-17 ERROR attempt=3 object=shard-12/abc123.envelope err=KMS:ThrottlingException message="Rate exceeded" trace_id=9f2b-... 
```
Irina: for incident playbook: if >5% of objects hitting DLQ within 10m, auto-pause job and notify #eng-oncall and #security on-call. record snapshot of manifest and first 1k failures.
Sam: final checklist before full run: 1) KMS key policy validated, 2) CloudTrail + Audit sink configured, 3) RBAC least privilege checked, 4) manifest checkpointing enabled, 5) DLQ/quarantine buckets with lifecycle.
Morgan: OK starting ramp plan: 0-10m -> 300r/s, 10-40m -> 600r/s, 40m+ -> 900r/s if metrics stable. watch latency p50 < 120ms, p95 < 500ms.
Anya: tagging: each rewrap audit entry should include +team:security +run:enc-recipher-1789993333 to help billing and compliance searches.
keyops-bot: job update: 1789993333 progress=14% completed=3200/22000 kms_throttle=12 quarantine=2 dlq=0
Morgan: thanks all — will post followups. if someone wants access to temp role for debugging ping me @Morgan.
